name: Investigate the Scourge of Ironforge
summary: The Scourge has reached the gates of Ironforge, and Lieutenant Nevell calls for defenders. Undead troops and glowing runic circles threaten Dun Morogh beneath a hovering necropolis.

sections.title: Death at the Mountain Gates
sections.body: The Scourge has brought its invasion to the mountain entrance of Ironforge. Floating necropolises cast their shadows over Dun Morogh’s frigid heights, far from Lordaeron and the plagued lands of the north. The Argent Dawn has placed observers there, including Lieutenant Nevell, to watch the undead and counter their spread before they breach the Bronzebeard fortress.

sections.title: Unholy Inscriptions
sections.body: Undead camps lie beneath the necropolis, marked by glowing runic circles and pulsing necrotic stones. Scouts who stand near the circles hear dark voices murmuring through the surrounding magic. Lieutenant Nevell believes the circles carry messages, but he does not know whom the Scourge is contacting.

faq.answer: Lieutenant Nevell is an Argent Dawn officer stationed at Ironforge to coordinate the defense against the Scourge. He asks defenders to collect necrotic stones and learn the purpose of the unholy sigils around the invaders’ camps.

faq.q: Why is the Scourge attacking Ironforge?
faq.answer: Scourge forces are camped beneath a necropolis outside Ironforge. Lieutenant Nevell asks defenders to thin their ranks and investigate the strange runic circles nearby.
Dim Necrotic Stones are recovered from Scourge invaders and brought to the Argent Dawn as proof that undead have been slain.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the glowing runic circles?
faq.answer: The glowing runic circles appear near the Scourge forces. Lieutenant Nevell asks you to investigate their purpose.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know the rot spreading across Dun Morogh’s clean snows is an outrage. The mountain entrance is your home’s threshold.
As an Alliance soldier, you know Ironforge is a vital economic and military pillar. An undead foothold at its gates threatens supply routes across the Eastern Kingdoms.
As a paladin, you oppose the Scourge, enemies of the Holy Light. You are called to investigate the Lich King’s runic malice and purge his mindless thralls.
As a priest, you know the whispers in the runic circles could threaten the sanity of ordinary soldiers. Resisting them demands spiritual strength.
